page: Microsoft Azure L16ps_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an ARM64 CPU architecture, the server provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 128.0 GB of memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware capabilities include a bundled local NVMe SSD configuration offering 3840 GB of fast, direct-attached ephemeral storage. The platform does not incorporate discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Alongside its internal NVMe tier, the instance supports Azure Premium Storage attachments for persistent disk workloads, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The integration of ARM processor efficiency with 3.8 TB of direct-attached NVMe storage yields high local I/O capacity relative to core count. This architecture suits I/O-heavy operations that benefit from high-throughput local scratch space or persistent distributed clustering, including relational databases, NoSQL data stores, search indexing engines, and data analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure L16ps_v5 is an ARM64 storage-optimized virtual machine provisioned on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system operates without discrete GPU acceleration and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The ARM-based compute structure offers an efficient processing tier suited for high-density local storage tasks. The L16ps_v5 is engineered for data-intensive production environments requiring substantial storage bandwidth and memory depth, such as relational database management systems, NoSQL datastores, real-time analytics engines, and transactional processing workloads.
